comment: Launcher contract for the assembled POSIX capsule. Do not change seed.sh to match this; the launcher consumes these paths.

path_policy.reason: Capsule sh/curl/jq/coreutils must win over any host curl.exe or Git-Bash tools. Host python/git/node/rg stay reachable after bin/.

process_notes.ps: msys2-runtime ships Cygwin-style ps.exe, not Linux procps. seed.sh uses `ps -eo pid= -o ppid=`; Windows process-tree kill is the launcher Job Object task.
process_notes.kill: msys2-runtime kill.exe. Do not expect Linux /proc semantics.
